name: combobox
summary: A searchable picker: type to filter a long list, then choose one item, such as a model, a preset or a collaborator.
useWhen: The list is long enough that scrolling is slow, such as dozens of presets or models.
People know roughly what they want and can type part of its name.

alternatives.name: select
alternatives.when: there are fewer than about ten options

alternatives.name: dropdown-menu
alternatives.when: the list holds actions, not a value

rules.do: Say what was searched and offer a next step when nothing matches, such as "No presets match 'neon'".
rules.dont: Show an empty panel with no message.

a11y: The input has the combobox role; arrow keys move through results and Enter selects.
Give the input a label (`aria-label`) naming what is being picked.
